create_ema_instance: create an ExponentialMovingAverage instance to maintain moving averages of model parameters
update_ema_parameters: update the exponential moving average shadow parameters after each optimizer step
copy_ema_to_model: copy the averaged shadow parameters into the model parameters for inference
save_ema_state_dict: save the ExponentialMovingAverage state including decay, num_updates, and shadow parameters
restore_ema_state_dict: restore the ExponentialMovingAverage from a previously saved state dictionary
